data.title: Ship Steno for Brandon’s Mac
Establish the Swift package and command-line app skeleton
data.body:
## Goal
- Create the smallest SwiftPM structure that builds a native macOS executable
  and test target without an Xcode project.

## Context
- Add `Package.swift`, `Package.resolved`, `Sources/Steno/`, and
  `Tests/StenoTests/`.
- Pin `argmax-oss-swift` exactly to 1.0.0 and depend on its `WhisperKit` product.
- Add only a minimal `@main` application shell; functional UI comes later.
- Every non-trivial source file needs the 5-15 line purpose and invariants
  comment required by `AGENTS.md`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `swift build` compiles using `/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools`.
- A placeholder unit test proves `swift test` discovers the test target.
- No `.xcodeproj`, `.xcworkspace`, project generator, or alternate build path
  exists.

## Validation Gates
- `swift build`
- `swift test`

data.title: Bundle offline model and tokenizer assets
data.body:
## Goal
- Make every inference asset available locally before the app starts.

## Context
- Store `openai_whisper-large-v3-v20240930_626MB` under `Resources/Models/`
  with large weights in Git-LFS.
- Store the complete `openai/whisper-large-v3` tokenizer snapshot under
  `Resources/Tokenizers/`.
- Preserve the pinned upstream revisions in one small asset manifest.
- A clean checkout may fetch these assets; runtime may not.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Build-time validation rejects missing files, unresolved Git-LFS pointer text,
  or an unexpected asset layout.
- Runtime preflight verifies the required model directories and tokenizer files
  before WhisperKit initialization and returns one local actionable error.
- WhisperKit configuration uses explicit `modelFolder` and `tokenizerFolder`,
  `load: false`, and `download: false`.
- No model or tokenizer selector or fallback path is added.

## Validation Gates
- `git lfs ls-files`
- `swift test --filter AssetPreflightTests`
- `swift build`

data.title: Implement the serialized transcription engine
data.body:
## Goal
- Transcribe one WAV at a time through the bundled WhisperKit model without
  cancellation races or stale UI results.

## Context
- Add one `TranscriptionEngine` actor that owns the sole WhisperKit instance.
- Load after Stop, unload after the owning task exits, and delete that task's WAV
  only after the file is no longer in use.
- Use a generation ID and a small injected test seam, not a general provider
  architecture.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A successful run returns text, unloads the model, and deletes its WAV.
- Cancellation is cooperative: a canceled generation cannot publish a result,
  unload beneath active inference, or overlap a second inference run.
- A second run waits for prior teardown rather than creating another model.
- Missing assets and transcription errors fail locally and clean up after the
  owning task exits.

## Validation Gates
- `swift test --filter TranscriptionEngineTests`
- `swift test --filter TranscriptionEngineConcurrencyTests`

data.title: Implement microphone recording and temporary-file cleanup
data.body:
## Goal
- Capture only the current microphone into one private 16 kHz mono PCM WAV.

## Context
- Use `AVAudioRecorder` and request permission only when Record is first used.
- Use unique Steno-owned temporary paths. Never expose a file picker or saved
  recording.
- Remove stale Steno WAV files at launch.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Recording start, stop, permission denial, unavailable input, device loss, and
  encode failure produce explicit outcomes for the session model.
- Stop closes a valid WAV for transcription.
- Reset while recording stops and deletes the WAV immediately.
- Launch cleanup removes only stale Steno-owned temporary WAV files.

## Validation Gates
- `swift test --filter RecorderTests`
- `swift test --filter TemporaryAudioCleanupTests`

data.title: Implement the session state model and headless product loop
data.body:
## Goal
- Make Record, Stop, Copy, Reset, errors, and late-result rejection one explicit
  main-actor state machine.

## Context
- States are idle, recording, transcribing, complete, and error.
- Compose the recorder and transcription engine through the smallest test seam.
- Clipboard output is plain text and is the only durable user output.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The headless loop proves idle to recording to transcribing to complete to idle.
- Copy writes the exact full transcript and is unavailable for empty results.
- Reset behavior is correct from every state and invalidates the generation
  before requesting transcription cancellation.
- Permission, recorder, asset, and transcription failures show actionable state.
- Late results from an invalid generation cannot change the current session.

## Validation Gates
- `swift test --filter SessionModelTests`
- `swift test --filter CompleteLoopTests`

data.title: Build the menu-bar panel
data.body:
## Goal
- Put the complete product loop in one small, visible macOS menu-bar accessory.

## Context
- Use `LSUIElement` with one status item, no Dock icon, and one floating panel
  that can join all Spaces.
- Use standard SwiftUI controls and the smallest AppKit bridge for `NSPanel` and
  a non-editable selectable transcript view.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Idle shows Record; recording shows the transcript placeholder and Stop;
  transcribing shows progress and Reset; complete shows selectable text, Copy,
  and Reset; errors show one sentence and Reset.
- Permission denial alone offers a link to the relevant System Settings page.
- The status item shows or hides the panel and exposes Quit.
- There is no history, settings, waveform, timer, navigation, or file UI.

## Validation Gates
- `swift test`
- `swift build -c release`
- Manually inspect every state using deterministic preview or injected test data.

data.title: Assemble, sandbox, install, and launch Steno.app
data.body:
## Goal
- Produce the sole local app bundle and install it on Brandon's Mac with the
  runtime network boundary enforced.

## Context
- Add fixed `Info.plist` and entitlements plus one repository install script.
- Set `LSUIElement` and `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription`.
- Entitlements contain `com.apple.security.app-sandbox = true` and
  `com.apple.security.device.audio-input = true`; omit network client access.
- Install atomically at `/Users/brandonharvey/Applications/Steno.app` and open
  it. Ad-hoc signing is sufficient for local V1.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The script runs the release build, validates assets, assembles the app, signs
  it with the fixed entitlements, replaces the installed app, and launches it.
- The installed bundle contains the executable, model, tokenizer, and metadata.
- Signature inspection proves App Sandbox and audio input are present and no
  network-client entitlement exists.
- Re-running the script is safe and leaves one installed copy.

## Validation Gates
- `./scripts/install.sh`
- `codesign --verify --deep --strict /Users/brandonharvey/Applications/Steno.app`
- `codesign --display --entitlements :- /Users/brandonharvey/Applications/Steno.app`

data.title: Create the fixed accuracy benchmark
data.body:
## Goal
- Make transcription quality a repeatable release test without committing
  private audio or reference transcripts.

## Context
- Commit `BenchmarkManifest.json` with stable sample IDs, durations, SHA-256
  digests, and the exact normalization contract.
- Keep audio and corrected references under ignored `Fixtures/`.
- Run the benchmark through the production transcription engine from the Swift
  test target; do not add a second transcription executable.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Fixture validation rejects missing files or digest mismatches.
- The benchmark computes aggregate and per-sample word error rate after the
  committed normalization and checks the silence hallucination limit.
- Gates are aggregate WER at most 10%, every sample at most 15%, and no five-word
  invented passage during ten seconds of silence.
- Results identify the app commit, model revision, tokenizer revision, decoding
  options, and manifest digest.

## Validation Gates
- `STENO_BENCHMARK_DIR=Fixtures swift test --filter AccuracyBenchmarkTests`

data.title: Validate and tune real meeting transcription
data.body:
## Goal
- Prove and, if needed, tune the pinned model against representative audio from
  Brandon's actual Mac and room conditions.

## Context
- Use three consented five-minute English samples: quiet speech, two-person
  discussion, and moderate room noise, plus ten seconds of silence.
- Tune only WhisperKit VAD and no-speech, log-probability, and compression-ratio
  thresholds before considering a different model.
- Keep fixtures and corrected references private and ignored.

## Acceptance Criteria
- All fixture digests match `BenchmarkManifest.json`.
- The committed decoding settings pass every accuracy and hallucination gate.
- `.scratch/accuracy-report.json` records measured results and peak transcription
  memory and elapsed time on Brandon's Mac.

## Checkpoint
- Produce: the installed working app, fixed private fixtures, corrected
  references, and `.scratch/accuracy-report.json`.
- Then ask: Do these recordings represent the rooms, microphones, and speech you
  care about well enough to accept them as the V1 quality gate?
- Do not change the model or proceed to final acceptance without approval.

## Validation Gates
- `STENO_BENCHMARK_DIR=Fixtures swift test --filter AccuracyBenchmarkTests`
- Inspect `.scratch/accuracy-report.json` against every gate in `SPEC.md`.

data.title: Complete local acceptance and handoff
data.body:
## Goal
- Leave the approved build installed, open, and immediately usable by Brandon.

## Context
- This is a local handoff, not a distribution release.
- Use the one install script and the current Mac only.

## Acceptance Criteria
- All automated tests and the approved accuracy benchmark pass from a clean
  worktree.
- The installed signature has App Sandbox plus audio input and no network client
  entitlement.
- With networking unavailable, Brandon completes one real Record, Stop, Copy,
  and Reset session and confirms the clipboard contains the full transcript.
- Reset leaves no visible data; completed inference removes its WAV; forced-exit
  residue is removed on relaunch.
- `/Users/brandonharvey/Applications/Steno.app` is running with its status item
  visible when the task finishes.

## Validation Gates
- `swift test`
- `STENO_BENCHMARK_DIR=Fixtures swift test --filter AccuracyBenchmarkTests`
- `./scripts/install.sh`
- `codesign --verify --deep --strict /Users/brandonharvey/Applications/Steno.app`
- Complete the manual offline product loop on Brandon's Mac.

## Goal
- Deliver the complete Steno V1 loop on Brandon's current Apple Silicon Mac:
  Record, Stop, local transcription, Copy, and Reset.
- Finish with the app installed at
  `/Users/brandonharvey/Applications/Steno.app`, open, and ready to use.

## Scope
- Native SwiftUI/AppKit menu-bar accessory built with Swift Package Manager.
- Microphone-only capture to one temporary WAV.
- Pinned WhisperKit 1.0.0, bundled compressed Large v3 Turbo Core ML model,
  and bundled `openai/whisper-large-v3` tokenizer.
- One serialized transcription engine, App Sandbox without network access,
  focused tests, a fixed accuracy benchmark, and one local install script.

## Decisions
- A clean source checkout may fetch SwiftPM and Git-LFS objects. The installed
  app cannot access the network or download assets at runtime.
- Reset clears the UI immediately. Inference cleanup completes only after the
  active task exits; late generations cannot update current state.
- Focused dependencies are allowed when they improve accuracy or remove real
  implementation risk. Keep one production path.
- V1 is for Brandon's current Mac only. Test only that machine.

## Non-goals
- Other users or Macs, system-audio capture, live transcription, diarization,
  persistence, history, file management, accounts, cloud services, launch at
  login, distribution signing, notarization, or an installer.

## Completion
- Every child is done, all automated and accuracy gates pass, the installed
  signature has App Sandbox plus audio input and no network client entitlement,
  and one real offline meeting-style session completes successfully.

data.title: Capture and approve the private benchmark corpus
data.body:
## Goal
- Capture and approve the fixed private corpus that represents Brandon's real
  microphone and room conditions.

## Context
- Use the production recorder through a test-only capture helper; do not add a
  capture or file-management path to the app.
- Capture three consented five-minute English samples: quiet speech, two-person
  discussion, and moderate room noise, plus ten seconds of silence.
- Correct the reference transcripts by hand and keep audio and references under
  ignored `Fixtures/`.
- Fill the committed `BenchmarkManifest.json` sample IDs, durations, audio and
  reference SHA-256 digests, capture device, and capture format.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every required fixture and corrected reference exists locally and matches the
  committed manifest.
- The capture uses Brandon's current Mac microphone and the same 16 kHz mono PCM
  format as production recording.
- `.scratch/corpus-summary.json` records the sample IDs, durations, capture
  device, manifest digest, and consent confirmation without private content.

## Checkpoint
- Produce: fixed private fixtures, corrected references,
  `BenchmarkManifest.json`, and `.scratch/corpus-summary.json`.
- Then ask: Do these recordings represent the rooms, microphones, and speech you
  care about well enough to accept them as the V1 quality corpus?
- Do not tune decoding or proceed to final acceptance without approval.

## Validation Gates
- `STENO_CAPTURE_FIXTURES=1 swift test --filter FixtureCaptureTests`
- `STENO_BENCHMARK_DIR=Fixtures swift test --filter FixtureManifestTests`
- Inspect `.scratch/corpus-summary.json` without exposing private content.

data.title: Prepare the model at app launch

data.body:
## Goal
- Specialize the pinned Core ML model when Steno launches so Stop is not the first expensive preparation point.

## Context
- Keep the model cache warm but unload model weights after preparation to preserve low idle memory.
- Preparation and transcription must share the existing TranscriptionEngine FIFO.
- Record stays unavailable until preparation succeeds; no download or network fallback.

## Acceptance Criteria
- App launch starts local model preparation exactly once and exposes preparing, ready, or failed readiness.
- Successful preparation unloads weights, enables Record, and leaves transcription using the same engine and assets.
- Reset cannot bypass readiness and preparation failure is actionable.
- Deterministic tests cover success, failure, and serialization with transcription.

## Validation Gates
- swift test --filter TranscriptionEnginePreparationTests
- swift test --filter SessionModelPreparationTests
- swift test

data.title: Keep speech assets stable across app installs
data.body:
## Goal
- Keep the pinned speech assets at one stable sandbox-container path so ordinary app replacement does not delete Core ML's specialization source.

## Context
- The app remains one signed, sandboxed process with no network entitlement.
- `/Users/brandonharvey/Library/Containers/com.brandonharvey.steno/Data/Library/Application Support/Steno/Resources` is the sole installed asset root.
- `Resources/` in the repository remains the build-time source. The installed app bundle must not contain a second model or tokenizer copy.
- `scripts/install.sh` owns installation because Steno is for Brandon's current Mac only. It must replace installed assets only when the pinned manifest changes or the installed set fails validation.
- App startup must derive its own container Application Support URL and load only the persistent root.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A first install atomically seeds the persistent resource root from the repository before launching Steno.
- A same-revision reinstall leaves the installed model files unchanged, including filesystem identity and modification time.
- A changed or incomplete asset set is atomically replaced before app launch.
- The app bundle contains no `Models` or `Tokenizers` directory.
- Runtime preflight, tests, specification, installer comments, and durable repo rules name the persistent asset path as authoritative.
- Installer failure leaves the previous complete resource root recoverable and does not launch an app against partial assets.

## Validation Gates
- `swift test`
- `swift build -c release`
- `bash -n scripts/install.sh`
- Installer-focused tests or deterministic shell inspection proving unchanged and replacement paths.

data.title: Verify specialization reuse after reinstall
data.body:
## Goal
- Prove that replacing Steno's application code no longer triggers Core ML specialization when the pinned model is unchanged.

## Context
- Run only after the persistent asset cutover is committed.
- Use the personal Apple Development identity and installed path already fixed by the project.
- Do not change the model, tokenizer, compute units, or WhisperKit backend during this verification.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Install and launch the cutover build; allow its one expected specialization from the newly persistent source to finish.
- Record the persistent model file identity and modification time.
- Re-run the installer without changing assets and confirm those values remain unchanged.
- The second launch reaches ready without an active `ANECompilerService` compilation and materially faster than the first launch.
- Complete one Record, Stop, Copy, Reset loop after the second launch.
- Leave the verified app installed, open, signed, sandboxed for microphone input, and without a network entitlement.

## Validation Gates
- `./scripts/install.sh`
- `codesign --verify --deep --strict /Users/brandonharvey/Applications/Steno.app`
- Compare persistent model inode and modification time across installs.
- Inspect privacy-safe Core ML and Steno logs for the two launch intervals.
- Complete the installed product loop.

# Ship Steno for Brandon’s Mac

## Goal
- Deliver the complete Steno V1 loop on Brandon's current Apple Silicon Mac:
  Record, Stop, local transcription, Copy, and Reset.
- Finish with the app installed at
  `/Users/brandonharvey/Applications/Steno.app`, open, and ready to use.

## Scope
- Native SwiftUI/AppKit menu-bar accessory built with Swift Package Manager.
- Microphone-only capture to one temporary WAV.
- Pinned WhisperKit 1.0.0 and compressed Large v3 Turbo Core ML assets installed once at Steno's sandbox Application Support path.
- One serialized transcription engine, App Sandbox without network access,
  focused tests, a fixed accuracy benchmark, and one local install script.

## Decisions
- A clean source checkout may fetch SwiftPM and Git-LFS objects. The installed
  app cannot access the network or download assets at runtime.
- The repository asset set is the install source; one persistent sandbox-container copy is authoritative at runtime and changes only with its pinned manifest.
- Replacing the app bundle must not replace unchanged model files or invalidate Core ML specialization.
- Reset clears the UI immediately. Inference cleanup completes only after the
  active task exits; late generations cannot update current state.
- Focused dependencies are allowed when they improve accuracy or remove real
  implementation risk. Keep one production path.
- V1 is for Brandon's current Mac only. Test only that machine.

## Non-goals
- Other users or Macs, system-audio capture, live transcription, diarization,
  persistence, history, file management, accounts, cloud services, launch at
  login, distribution signing, notarization, or a general-purpose installer.

## Completion
- Every child is done, all automated and accuracy gates pass, the installed
  signature has App Sandbox plus audio input and no network client entitlement,
  unchanged app installs reuse model specialization, and one real offline
  meeting-style session completes successfully.

A same-commit reinstall preserved model inode 97598569 and mtime 1784749159 exactly; the app was ready within the 22-second build-sign-install-launch inspection interval and ANECompilerService remained idle.

Verified specialization reuse end to end. First launch from the new persistent source required one observed preparation of about six minutes. The unchanged reinstall preserved model inode 97598569 and mtime 1784749159, reached ready within the 22-second build-sign-install-launch inspection interval, and produced no ANE compilation events. The installed Record, Stop, Copy, Reset loop returned and copied the expected synthetic text; Stop-to-complete was 1.6 seconds. Personal signature, team GS88W79LPB, sandbox, microphone entitlement, no network entitlement, 3.3 MB app bundle, sole 620 MB persistent asset tree, and 180256 KB idle RSS were verified.

data.title: Externalize Steno speech assets
data.body:
## Goal
- Keep source history small while preserving one exact, offline runtime model.

## Decisions
- Track only the pinned manifest and integrity contract.
- Download assets explicitly with a pinned developer-only Hugging Face CLI.
- Install assets directly and atomically into Steno Application Support.
- Allow ordinary builds and tests without speech assets.

## Non-goals
- No app networking, runtime download, model selection, or parallel asset path.

data.title: Add deterministic asset preparation
data.body:
## Goal
- Add one deterministic script that downloads the pinned model and tokenizer directly into the installed Application Support resource root.

## Context
- Read repository IDs, revisions, paths, and integrity hashes from Resources/AssetManifest.json.
- Use uvx with a pinned hf CLI only in the developer script.
- Stage and verify before atomic replacement; do not alter a valid installed tree.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The script downloads only the selected Core ML directory and tokenizer files.
- Failed or incomplete downloads leave the installed tree untouched.
- Re-running against a valid tree performs no download or replacement.

## Validation Gates
- Exercise selection with hf download --dry-run.
- Verify the prepared tree against the current known-good assets.

data.title: Cut build and install over to external assets
data.body:
## Goal
- Make compilation, tests, and app installation use the external installed asset contract instead of repository model files.

## Context
- Package.swift must not inspect untracked model files.
- install.sh must verify installed assets and point users to prepare-model.sh when absent.
- Keep runtime preflight fail-closed and app networking disabled.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Remove tracked Models and Tokenizers trees and Git-LFS configuration.
- A model-free checkout can resolve, build, and run non-integration tests.
- Existing installed assets still pass runtime preflight and support fast reinstall.
- SPEC.md and AGENTS.md describe the one-copy bootstrap contract.

## Validation Gates
- swift test
- swift build -c release
- ./scripts/install.sh with the existing installed asset tree

data.title: Rewrite unpublished history and publish
data.body:
## Goal
- Remove model objects from all unpublished history and publish the lean repository.

## Context
- GitHub origin is empty; rewrite before first branch publication.
- Preserve the current work through a recoverable local backup reference until verification finishes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- No reachable commit contains Models, Tokenizers, or Git-LFS pointers.
- A fresh model-free clone builds and tests without downloading speech assets.
- origin/main equals the verified local main commit.

## Validation Gates
- git lfs ls-files returns empty.
- git rev-list --objects --all contains no removed asset paths on the published branch.
- git push -u origin main and git ls-remote origin verify the commit.
